dleplugin.name: DLE Social AutoPost (VK & Telegram)
dleplugin.description: Автоматическая публикация пресс-релизов и новостей в Telegram-канал и группу ВКонтакте с поддержкой очередей, кастомного Endpoint API (зеркала / прокси), UTM-меток, CRON и умного поиска изображений.
dleplugin.filelist: engine/classes/autopost/Autopost.php engine/classes/autopost/Config.php engine/classes/autopost/Logger.php engine/classes/autopost/MediaHelper.php engine/classes/autopost/Queue.php engine/classes/autopost/TelegramClient.php engine/classes/autopost/TemplateEngine.php engine/classes/autopost/VkClient.php engine/inc/autopost.php engine/skins/images/autopost.png cron/autopost.php
dleplugin.mysqlinstall:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{prefix}_autopost_queue` (
 `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 `news_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
 `target` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',
 `status` enum('pending','processing','failed','done') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
 `attempts` tinyint(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 `error_message` text,
 `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
 `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 KEY `status` (`status`),
 KEY `news_id` (`news_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `{prefix}_autopost_log` (
 `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 `news_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
 `channel` enum('telegram','vk') NOT NULL,
 `remote_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
 `status` enum('success','error') NOT NULL,
 `error_message` text,
 `post_date` datetime NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
 KEY `news_id` (`news_id`),
 KEY `status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

dleplugin.mysqluninstall: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{prefix}_autopost_queue`;\nDROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{prefix}_autopost_log`;\nDELETE FROM `{prefix}_admin_sections` WHERE `name` = 'autopost';
